# Violin plot of a-diversity

## Load packages and functions

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
```

# Import taxonomic a-diversity dataset

```{r}
design <- read.csv("Metadata.csv", header = T)
# Taxonomic a-diversity
data1 <- read.csv("Species_alpha_diversity_Rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data <- cbind(design, data1) # merge design and a-diversity
```

# Plot parameters

```{r}
colors <- c("irrigated"="#4169B2", "non-irrigated"="#BB2BA0")
theme.plot <- theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 17),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(colour= "black", size= 17, angle= 35, hjust = 1),
                    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 17),
                    legend.position = "NULL",
                    panel.border = element_rect(color="black", size=1),
                    panel.grid = element_blank())
```


```{r}
########### Shannon ####################
range(data$Shannon)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Shannon, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth=0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Shannon") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(3.9, 4.6), breaks =seq(3.9, 4.65, 0.2)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 4.6, label = "P = 0.011", size = 6)

p1
ggsave("Shannon_taxonomic.pdf", p1, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F= 6.2, P=0.015**


########### Observed species ####################
range(data$S)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= S, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Richness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(6000, 8650), breaks = seq(6000, 8600, 500)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 8630, label = "P = 0.560", size = 6)

p2
ggsave("Richness_taxonomic.pdf", p2, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F= 0.34, P = 0.560


########### Pielou_evenness ####################
range(data$Pielou_evenness)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p3 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Pielou_evenness, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Pielou evenness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.445, 0.510), breaks = seq(0.445, 0.515, 0.02)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.510, label = "P = 0.008", size = 6)

p3
ggsave("Pielou_evenness_taxonomic.pdf", p3, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F= 8.23, P = 0.008**

```


## α-diversity of functional genes

```{r}
design <- read.csv("Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data2 <- read.csv("KOs_alpha_diveristy_Rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data <- cbind(design, data2)
```


```{r}
########### Shannon ####################
range(data$Shannon)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p5 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Shannon, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth=0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Shannon") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(7.49, 7.61), breaks =seq(7.49, 7.61, 0.03)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7.61, label = "P = 0.113", size = 6)

p5
ggsave("Shannon_function.pdf", p5, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F = 2.58, P=0.113


########### Observed species ####################
range(data$S)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p6 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= S, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Richness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(6770, 7800), breaks = seq(6770, 7800, 500)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7800, label = "P = 1.00", size = 6)

p6
ggsave("Richness_function.pdf", p6, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F=0.00, P=0.986


########### Pielou_evenness ####################
range(data$Pielou_evenness)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p7 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Pielou_evenness, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 1.4, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Pielou evenness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.841, 0.863), breaks = seq(0.84, 0.862, 0.01)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.863, label = "P = 0.244", size = 6)

p7
ggsave("Pielou evenness_function.pdf", p7, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F=1.38, P=0.244

```
